config.enabled.name: Enable cloud shadows
config.enabled.tooltip: Fade cloud shadows in or out. Once disabled, Overcast stops updating and drawing clouds.
config.opacity.name: Maximum opacity
config.opacity.tooltip: The clear-day strength before weather, time of day, mask edges, and layer tuning reduce it.
config.speed.name: Wind speed
config.speed.tooltip: Multiplies Overcast's gentle built-in cloud drift speed.
config.scale.name: Cloud scale
config.scale.tooltip: Multiplies the varied size of every cloud mask.
config.enable-at-night.name: Enable at night
config.enable-at-night.tooltip: Keep weather-appropriate cloud shadows active overnight instead of fading them out at evening.
config.enable-during-rain.name: Enable during rain
config.enable-during-rain.tooltip: Show a reduced cloud-shadow effect during rain and obscuring wet weather.
config.enable-during-snow.name: Enable during snow
config.enable-during-snow.tooltip: Show a reduced cloud-shadow effect during snow, blizzards, and rain-snow mixtures.
config.enable-during-storms.name: Enable during storms
config.enable-during-storms.tooltip: Show a reduced cloud-shadow effect during lightning and severe weather.
config.enable-during-special-weather.too: Show a reduced cloud-shadow effect during heatwaves and unrecognized Weather Wonders effects.
config.second-layer-enabled.name: Enable second layer
config.second-layer-enabled.tooltip: Add a sparse, lower-strength secondary cloud layer for a little more variation.
